name: canli-validation-mcp
description: Check a backtest before you trust it: deflated Sharpe, backtest overfitting (CSCV), paper-evidence and breadth, each with a recomputable receipt.
long_description: Tools over canlicapital.com's free validation API. Every result is the full API envelope, including the sentences that say what a number does not establish. Also reads a company's SEC-reported financial history. Your returns are not stored: the API keeps a SHA-256 hash of the input and the verdict.

tools.name: get_key
tools.description: Issue a free validation key for this session

tools.name: validate_overfitting
tools.description: Probability of backtest overfitting by CSCV

tools.name: validate_paper_evidence
tools.description: Conformance of a record to canli.paper-evidence.v0

tools.name: validate_breadth
tools.description: Breadth ceiling for a book of sleeves

tools.name: validate_track_record
tools.description: Minimum track record length to clear a benchmark Sharpe

tools.name: validate_backtest_length
tools.description: Minimum backtest length for N trials, or the trials a backtest's years allow

tools.name: validate_haircut_sharpe
tools.description: Haircut Sharpe ratio for the number of tests run

tools.name: audit_backtest
tools.description: Deflated Sharpe, track record and overfitting on one series in one call

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Check a receipt's signature offline against the published key

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: A free key from canlicapital.com/developers. Leave empty and the get_key tool issues one for the session.

local_only.title: Private local mode
local_only.description: Run the validators on this computer. Nothing about your series is sent to canlicapital.com and no receipt is stored.
